reborn-1167.rationale: Current official TCG text requires Makyura to be sent from the Monster Zone to the GY, then permits exactly 1 Trap Card to be activated from the hand that turn, with a once-per-turn limit on Makyura's effect. The pinned executable Lua triggers optionally on EVENT_TO_GRAVE, requires the previous location to be LOCATION_MZONE, applies the hard once-per-turn count limit by card ID, and on resolution registers EFFECT_TRAP_ACT_IN_HAND with its own count limit of 1 until the End Phase. The BabelCDB display text has extra legacy/OCG explanatory wording, but the exact pinned executable behavior matches the current official TCG effect. Therefore the engine implementation is suitable for Reborn's latest-errata requirement without an override.

note: Script-hash-bound review confirming current TCG Makyura the Destructor behavior; no simulator override required.
